# platform.claude.com documentation — Build With Claude — Prompt Engineering

> 6 page(s) of platform.claude.com documentation — Build With Claude under Prompt Engineering. Part of the index one level up (../llms.txt).

## Prompt Engineering

- [Before prompt engineering](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/build-with-claude/prompt-engineering/overview.md): This guide focuses on success criteria that are controllable through prompt engineering. Not every success criteria or failing eval is best solved by prompt engineering.
- [Claude Fable 5](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/build-with-claude/prompt-engineering/claude-prompting-best-practices.md): Prompting guidance for Claude Fable 5 and Claude Mythos 5 has its own page: [Prompting Claude Fable…
- [Capability improvements](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/build-with-claude/prompt-engineering/prompting-claude-fable-5.md): Compared with Claude Opus 4.8, Claude Fable 5 shows improvement in:
- [Response length and verbosity](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/build-with-claude/prompt-engineering/prompting-claude-opus-4-8.md): Claude Opus 4.8 calibrates response length to how complex it judges the task to be, rather than defaulting to a fixed verbosity.
- [Capability improvements](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/build-with-claude/prompt-engineering/prompting-claude-opus-5.md): Compared with Claude Opus 4.8, the improvements most relevant to prompting are:
- [Response length and verbosity](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/build-with-claude/prompt-engineering/prompting-claude-sonnet-5.md): Claude Sonnet 5 calibrates response length to the complexity of the task rather than defaulting to a fixed verbosity.
